open_questions: FY2025 buyback pace (**$587M**) alongside **$1.30B** Elo deal: validate leverage tolerance and repurchase cadence for 2026.
AVA segment margin trajectory post-Photoneo/Matrox: thin profitability may be cyclical or structural.
Live price quote confirmation for stance gate.
thesis: Zebra Technologies is an enterprise asset intelligence company that sells rugged mobile computers, barcode and RFID data capture, label printers, machine vision, self-service touchscreens, and attached software and services to frontline workers in retail, manufacturing, transportation, and healthcare. **[Fact]** FY2025 consolidated net sales were **$5.40 billion** (+**8.3%** versus 2024) with operating income of **$700 million** (~**13.0%** margin) and net income of **$419 million** (**$8.18** diluted earnings per share). **[Fact]** In 2025 the company reorganized into two reportable segments: **Connected Frontline (CF)** ($2.96 billion sales, **$585 million** operating income) and **Asset Visibility and Automation (AVA)** ($2.44 billion sales, ~**$115 million** operating income). **[Fact]** Free cash flow was about **$831 million** in FY2025 (cash from operations **$917 million** less capital spending **$86 million**), or roughly **$16.23** per diluted share on **51.2 million** shares.
why_market_wrong: There is **no clear dated mispricing signal** (predictive attribute: **none**). **[Inference]** The stock may already reflect a durable installed-base franchise and recent automation adjacency deals (Matrox, Photoneo, Elo). **[Fact]** Q1 2026 net sales rose **14.3%** year over year to **$1.50 billion** with operating income **$215 million** (+**10%**), which may indicate recovery momentum not fully priced if the market is anchored to FY2025 margin compression from the Elo integration. Return is **normalized free cash flow per share at price**, not a single catalyst with a payoff date.
